title: Scorecards
intro: How each agent’s calls turned out. Code scores them every night at 00:15, Baghdad time, once the outcome is known.
pfIntro: The same scorecards as on the Agents page, with the P&L of the trades each agent led.
throughTip: Scored every night at 00:15, Baghdad time. A day is scored once its 24 or 48 hour window has closed.
shorter: Atlas has {{n}} days of scores, so {{period}} shows those {{n}}.
stale: Scoring hasn’t run for a few nights, so these scores stop at <f>{{date}}</f>. Atlas tries again at 00:15.

w.title: How much each vote counts
w.sub: Each voter’s weight is 0.5 plus the share of its votes that turned out right over the last 30 days. Under 10 scored votes it stays at 1.0×.
w.always30: Weights always use the last 30 days, whatever period you pick.

voteTip: Its vote counts {{w}} in the weighted vote. {{detail}}.
ndAria: {{label}}: not enough data, {{n}} cases of the {{min}} it needs.
trendAria: {{label}}, 7-day value by day over {{period}}: from {{from}} to {{to}}.
trendNone: The line starts once there’s enough data.

cal.aria: Said {{said}} on average; {{happened}} happened. {{verdict}}. Brier score {{brier}}.
cal.brier: Brier <f>{{v}}</f>; a coin flip scores 0.25, lower is better.

m.selection_edgeSub: Its picks moved <f>{{v}}</f> more than the rest of the shortlist in the next 24 hours.
m.selection_edgeSubLess: Its picks moved <f>{{v}}</f> less than the rest of the shortlist in the next 24 hours.
m.calHistSub: How often “it rose in X% of cases” held, over <f>{{n}}</f> statements
m.rrSub: Stated <f>{{exp}}</f> on average, against a <f>{{target}}</f> target, <f>{{n}}</f> setups
m.calStrat: Chance of TP1 before the stop
m.regretSub: <f>{{n}}</f> ideas. Below zero, skipping them was right.
m.capturedSub: Realised R as a share of the best R reached, <f>{{n}}</f> trades
m.loopsSub: Debates it cut short and sent to a vote

err.title: Scorecards didn’t load
err.body: Atlas couldn’t reach its own server. Check that Atlas is running with <cmd>./atlas up</cmd>, then try again.

empty.title: No scores yet
empty.body: Code scores each agent at 00:15, Baghdad time, once the first day’s outcomes are known. The first scorecards appear tomorrow morning.
